reviews.text:
RENDALE. Rendale! A real scam! I booked a room and made a point of asking the receptionist before booking whether it was clean. He gave me a room with four bunk beds, a dirty floor, and a bathroom in the same condition. I went back to tell him this was not serious and that I was going to cancel. I hope they refund my deposit and that Kayak reimburses me. And the receptionist was really rude.

In the end, I went to Hilton across the street. Pretty much the same price, but there’s absolutely no comparison. It just shows that sometimes it’s better to stick with established standards.

Anyway, a terrible start to my time in Washington, but fortunately I managed to turn it around thanks to the Hilton staff.

reviews.text: Bait and Switch. You think you’re booking with a reputable site but they use a lot of third-party hookers and I’ve had nothing but problems with them. Right now I’m stuck in Italy without a ticket even though I paid for one and every time I call their third-party vendor they keep hanging up.. They don’t want to fix the problem they would rather me miss my flight and then have to pay them a fee again and this is 100% their fault. I flew from San Francisco to Rome and because of weather in New York, the first leg of my flight was delayed 12 hours, causing me to miss the flight from New York to Rome. That part is nobody’s fault that’s just the weather. But when it was a time for me to return and fly from Rome to San Francisco, they canceled my first leg because they thought that I never made the first flight from New York to Rome. I caught the problem five days before my flight and was told for the first four days that it would be “fixed by tomorrow”. Now that it’s time for me to fly every time I call this third-party vendor they hear the entire story, place me on hold, and then the phone mysteriously disconnects. Just booked with an airline directly, and your life will be easier!
